title: Lame's thick cylinder, nearly incompressible
model: lame_rate's quarter cylinder in TPU (E 7.8 MPa, nu 0.48: bulk modulus 17 times the shear); 1 mm elements; the bore's mean radial displacement, from probe_study's rigid fit of the face

u_r_bore.source: Lame; Timoshenko & Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed. (1970), ch. 4, the thick-walled cylinder under uniform pressure, in plane strain
u_r_bore.reason: an element that locks is too stiff as nu nears 1/2, and its displacement falls short of Lame by far more than its mesh error; a fully integrated tet10 at nu 0.48 does not lock, and at 1 mm should read within half a percent. MacNeal and Harder's thick cylinder asks the same at nu 0.49 to 0.4999, which no material of the library has (docs/simulation/reference-cases.md says so)
